title: Let your team's agents talk and share files directly
summary: At Spoki, where every staff member has their own agents, a teammate built a private network so the original agents can message each other and pass files.
agent_role: Each person's agent keeps its own memory and can contact colleagues' agents directly to ask for help or send files. People choose which agents to connect.
outcome: The author says each agent stays best at its job and together they work like a team.
what_they_did: Spoki's whole team uses personal agents. Sharing used to mean copying an agent, and the copy lost its memory and know-how. A team member built a private network where the original agents talk and send files. Each person installs it once and picks which agents to connect.
how_it_went: The author says the agents now work together like an actual team, with each keeping its strengths.
worth_knowing: The motivation is that copied agents start from scratch and lose what they learned working with their owner.

curation.rationale: A real team setup where colleagues' original agents talk to each other and swap files instead of using blank copies; an interesting idea but thin on detail and lightly promotional.
